security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown examples, documentation URLs, XML ellipses, and PptxGenJS guidance. The audit confirms two medium workflow risks: PPTX archive extraction guidance lacks path validation, and temporary file guidance does not require unique private temp paths. No prompt injection, credential access, or data exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: PPTX archive extraction guidance does not require path validation.
remediation.suggestion: When unpacking PPTX files, reject absolute paths and entries containing parent directory traversal before extraction.

remediation.issue: Temporary output guidance uses /tmp without requiring unique private paths.
remediation.suggestion: Create a unique temporary directory with restrictive permissions, then move the finished PPTX to the user-approved destination.

content.value_statement: PowerPoint work often needs structured slides, brand consistency, and reliable template edits. This skill guides deck creation, PPTX XML edits, and text extraction workflows.
actual_capabilities: Creates PowerPoint decks from scratch with PptxGenJS slide modules.
Defines cover, agenda, section divider, content, and summary slide patterns.
Edits existing PPTX templates through XML unpack, edit, clean, and repack steps.
Extracts presentation text with markitdown for review and QA.
Provides design guidance for color palettes, typography, spacing, charts, and badges.
Documents common PptxGenJS pitfalls that can corrupt files or damage layout.
limitations: Requires local Python and Node tooling for extraction, editing, or deck generation.
Complex template edits can still need manual visual inspection in PowerPoint.
Remote images or links depend on user approval, availability, and network access.
It does not replace legal, brand, or accessibility review for final presentations.

use_cases.title: Consulting Deck Draft
use_cases.description: Turn research notes into a structured client presentation with cover, agenda, content, and summary slides.

use_cases.title: Template Refresh
use_cases.description: Update an existing branded PPTX while preserving layouts, images, charts, and slide order.

use_cases.title: Presentation Audit
use_cases.description: Extract slide text and review the deck for missing content, placeholders, and formatting problems.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Deck
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner deck creation from a short brief.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 6-slide PowerPoint deck about [topic] for [audience]. Use a clear agenda, varied layouts, and a concise summary.

prompt_templates.title: Edit a Template
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate update of a branded source file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use [template.pptx] as the source deck. Replace placeholders with [content] and keep the original visual style.

prompt_templates.title: Build With Data
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate deck with charts and sourced material.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 10-slide deck from [research notes]. Add charts where useful and explain each slide choice briefly.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Template Rebuild
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced XML edit with slide mapping and QA.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [existing.pptx], map my new outline to the best slides, edit the XML safely, and deliver edited.pptx.

output_examples.input: Create a sales kickoff deck for regional managers.
output_examples.output: A PPTX with cover, agenda, market context, goals, team actions, timeline, and summary slides.

output_examples.input: Update a branded template with new product launch content.
output_examples.output: An edited PPTX that preserves the template structure and replaces old placeholder text.

output_examples.input: Extract and review text from an existing board deck.
output_examples.output: A text summary of slide titles, key bullet points, and detected missing content.

best_practices: Provide audience, purpose, slide count, brand colors, and source material before asking for a deck.
Use local image files or approved asset URLs to avoid broken images and privacy issues.
Verify the final PPTX with text extraction and a visual review before sharing it.
anti_patterns: Asking for many slides without a clear outline or content source.
Using remote images without checking rights, availability, and security requirements.
Skipping QA after template edits, especially after changing slide order or XML content.

faq.question: Can it create a PowerPoint file from scratch?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides PptxGenJS slide generation, theme setup, slide modules, and final PPTX compilation.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing template?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains how to copy, unpack, modify, clean, and repack a PPTX template.

faq.question: Does it preserve brand design?
faq.answer: It can follow existing layouts, palettes, fonts, and spacing when those assets are provided.

faq.question: What tools does it use?
faq.answer: It references PptxGenJS for creation, markitdown for text extraction, and Python zip workflows for PPTX editing.

faq.question: Can it extract text from slides?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses markitdown to read presentation text for analysis and quality checks.

faq.question: Does it guarantee perfect rendering?
faq.answer: No. Final decks need text extraction checks and visual review in a presentation viewer.
